summary: Packs multiple event parameters into a single bitfield word and writes it to this+0, stores a secondary payload word in this+4, and resets the flag field at this+0x1AC to -1. The packed value is computed from an indexed global base: result = a5 + ((a4 + ((a3 + ((dword_7C56A4 + 8*(a7 + 4*a2)) << 6)) << 10)) << 8). Returns the packed value. Heavily used by UI/progress-bar and session-event callers to enqueue progress bar UI events.

local_names.dword_7C56A4: global base array indexed into by the packed event selector

operations.description: Compute the packed event word: load dword_7C56A4, index into it with 8*(a7 + 4*a2), then apply three left-shift/accumulate stages (<<6, <<10, <<8) and add a5, a4, a3. The result is returned and stored at this+0.
Store the computed packed event bitfield word into this+0.
Store the secondary event data word (a6 parameter) into this+4.
Reset the flag field at this+0x1AC to -1.
Return the packed event word as the function result.

unresolved: The exact bit positions of a2/a3/a4/a5/a7 within the packed word and the meaning of the global base dword_7C56A4 index are not derivable from this packet alone.
this+0x1AC is set to -1 as a reset; its reader-side semantics are outside this function.
